# Castle Rock SEO

> Castle Rock SEO (castlerock-seo.com) provides SEO, Google Maps optimization, search advertising, web design and AI search optimization for businesses in Castle Rock, Castle Pines and Douglas County, Colorado. It is powered by Eye To Ad Media, a marketing agency founded in 2012 and headquartered at 1001 Bannock St #660, Denver, CO 80204.

Phone 1-800-481-8638. BBB A+ accredited, 5.0 on Google across 60 reviews. No long lock-in contracts; clients own everything built for them; rankings are never guaranteed. Websites from $99 a month on a subscribe-to-own plan for qualifying businesses. Machine-readable business data: https://castlerock-seo.com/api/business.json

Castle Rock market facts (U.S. Census Bureau QuickFacts): 83,815 residents (July 2025 estimate), up 14.6% since 2020; 28,219 households; median household income $145,197.
